theme: Those who cleanse the inner field and remain steady in virtue are freed from the delusion of opposites and turn to the Lord.
context: Krishna contrasts the preceding delusion with virtuous people whose sins have ended, who are free from the delusion of opposites and worship him with firm vows.
contextHindi: कृष्ण अब पुण्यकर्मी लोगों का वर्णन करते हैं जिनके पाप समाप्त हुए हैं। वे द्वन्द्वमोह से मुक्त होकर दृढ़ व्रत के साथ उनकी उपासना करते हैं।
sanskritDevanagari:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् |
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ||७-२८||
transliteration:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām .
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ ||7-28||

wordByWord.meaning: of those; a specific class of seekers is being named.
the sins of those people have come to an end.
of those whose actions are wholesome, ethically oriented, and spiritually constructive.
freed from the delusion of dualities; no longer mastered by attraction and aversion.
steadfast in vow or disciplined commitment; firm in inward resolve.

spokenHindi: यहाँ कृष्ण उन लोगों का वर्णन करते हैं जिनके पापों का अंत हो चुका है। वे पुण्य कर्म करने वाले हैं। वे द्वन्द्वों के मोह से मुक्त होकर दृढ़ व्रत के साथ भगवान की भक्ति करते हैं। श्लोक में पापों के अंत की बात कही गई है; यह नहीं बताया गया कि यह अंत किस प्रक्रिया से हुआ। द्वन्द्वों का मोह सुख-दुख, लाभ-हानि या अनुकूल-प्रतिकूल अनुभवों से जुड़ी उलझन है। इससे मुक्त होना श्लोक में इन भक्तों की एक विशेषता के रूप में आता है। दृढ़व्रत का अर्थ है अपने संकल्प में स्थिर रहना। श्लोक का सीधा कथन है कि ऐसे पुण्य कर्म करने वाले लोग भगवान की भक्ति करते हैं। यह वर्णन किसी को दोष देने के लिए नहीं है। इसे पढ़ते हुए हम अपने कर्मों और संकल्पों पर शांतिपूर्वक विचार कर सकते हैं। अपने लिए छोटा संकल्प चुनना इस वर्णन का आधुनिक अनुप्रयोग है। जैसे किसी कठिन बातचीत से पहले रुककर उत्तर देना। संकल्प टूटे तो स्वयं को अपमानित करने के बजाय उसकी कठिनाई समझकर फिर प्रयास करें।
clearEnglish: This verse describes people whose sins have come to an end and who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites. It says that these people, described as virtuous in their actions, worship Krishna with firm vows. The phrase “whose sins have come to an end” is the verse’s stated condition; the verse does not define it here as a particular psychological state or say that wrong action is merely less dominant. Likewise, being free from the delusion of opposites and worshipping with steadfast resolve are stated in the verse. Ideas about how ethical consistency or inner steadiness may support devotion can be offered as interpretation, but they should not be confused with the verse’s direct wording. The verse presents devotion as the action of those who meet these conditions. A contemporary practice may take inspiration from firm vows through a manageable commitment, such as pausing before a difficult reply. That practice should allow repair after mistakes rather than demanding impossible control of every thought.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse says that people whose sins have come to an end, who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship the Lord with steadfast vows. It does not explain the phrase “sins have come to an end” as a particular psychological condition.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The firm-vow description can inspire one manageable ethical commitment; it does not define purification as suppressing feelings or prove that a particular exercise ends sin.

practicalApplication.label: Daily repair
practicalApplication.text: At the end of the day, review one harmful reaction that you repeated. Name it, accept responsibility for it, and choose one better response to practice tomorrow.

practicalApplication.label: A manageable commitment
practicalApplication.text: For one day, pause before sending an angry reply. If you forget, acknowledge it and try again, without demanding control of every thought.

reflectionQuestion: What pattern in my life keeps me trapped in the cycle of reaction, and what one steady act of virtue could loosen that grip?
reflectionQuestionHindi: मेरे जीवन में कौन-सी आदत मुझे प्रतिक्रिया के चक्र में बांधे रखती है, और एक दृढ़ सदाचारी कर्म क्या है जो उस जकड़न को ढीला कर सकता है?
